problems: Repair 2026-10-19: all three dossiers re-validated with --resolve, 0 errors 0 warnings. 7 fixes applied (3 vassal-event sets: indo-sasanian-empire vassal_start 260 and vassal_end 360 for the north; lakhmid-kingdom vassal_start 270 and vassal_end 602; ghassanids vassal_start 510, vassal_end 617, vassal_start 629, vassal_end 633 with eastern-roman-empire and vassal_start 633, vassal_end 636 with byzantine-empire; the Lakhmid found region intersected with the Lakhmid shape (114 cells); the Ghassanid /ledger/1 note, the 'After two or three years' quote in /keyframe_review/2, /wars/1 and notes, and the contiguous ruler strip). The reviewer's own edits (indo /wars/0 and /wars/3, lakhmid /wars/3, ghassanids /ledger/7-8) were left as set.

Disagreements with the reviewer, recorded in notes: (1) ghassanids /ledger/2 keeps 'withdrawing to Anatolia (undated)', now quoted from the Ghassanids page ('a withdrawal by the Ghassanids to Anatolia where they fight alongside Heraclius', in the paragraph on Heraclius's counteroffensive to Nineveh 627; Jabalah's 639 withdrawal is a different sentence); (2) lakhmid-kingdom vassal_start 270 is confidence 1, not 2, because 270 is Cliopatria's year and the page's own dates are c. 293 and later; (3) ghassanids ends the Eastern Roman tint in 633 (not 632) so the byzantine-empire start in the same year leaves no untinted year; (4) indo-sasanian-empire has one vassal_start (whole shape) and one vassal_end (north, 360) with the south leaving through the 358 loss, because the validator pairs ends with starts one to one.

Requests to other batches, not mine to edit: me-06-c sasanian-empire /ledger/39 vassal_end indo-sasanian-empire to 360 over the north (or both 358), a 350-358 contest with indo-sasanian-empire, the Lakhmid cells of 629-633 with a May 633 loss to rashidun-caliphate, a 617 gain from ghassanids (544 cells) and the 629 return to ghassanids (not eastern-roman-empire); eu-05 eastern-roman-empire a 510 ledger loss of 54 cells to ghassanids and one year for the vassal_end (613 there, 617 here), byzantine-empire /ledger/1 vassal_end 633 to 636 with a vassal_start 633; me-07 rashidun-caliphate the 634-636 contest and 636 loss; kidarites the predecessor slug indo-sasanian-empire; sa-02 western-kushans the client relation for 240-259.
